_status: DRAFT - local names need review by native speaking clinicians before the pilot

haemoglobin.plain_en: the protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen

hba1c.plain_en: average blood sugar over the last 2 to 3 months

blood sugar.plain_en: the amount of sugar in your blood

cholesterol.plain_en: a fat-like substance in the blood

ldl.plain_en: the kind of cholesterol that can build up in blood vessels

hdl.plain_en: the kind of cholesterol that helps clear other cholesterol

triglycerides.plain_en: a type of fat in the blood

thyroid.plain_en: a gland in the neck that controls how the body uses energy

tsh.plain_en: a hormone that tells the thyroid how hard to work
tsh.hi: TSH (थायरॉइड को संकेत देने वाला हार्मोन)
tsh.hinglish: TSH (thyroid ko signal dene wala hormone)

kidney function.plain_en: how well the kidneys filter the blood

creatinine.plain_en: a waste product the kidneys clear from the blood

egfr.plain_en: an estimate of how well the kidneys filter
egfr.hinglish: eGFR (kidney ki filter karne ki kshamta)

liver.plain_en: the organ that processes nutrients and clears toxins

vitamin d.plain_en: a vitamin that keeps bones and muscles healthy

vitamin b12.plain_en: a vitamin needed for nerves and red blood cells

iron.plain_en: a mineral the body needs to make haemoglobin

ferritin.plain_en: a protein that shows how much iron the body has stored

anaemia.plain_en: fewer healthy red blood cells or less haemoglobin than normal

high blood pressure.plain_en: blood pushing too hard against the vessel walls

diabetes.plain_en: a condition where blood sugar stays too high

crp.plain_en: a marker that rises with inflammation

reference range.plain_en: the range of values the lab treats as usual
